list.snippet: Daily Average: Processing roughly 66 crore to 76 crore transactions daily.
Market Share: Powers approximately 85% of all retail digital payments in India.
Global Reach: Accounts for nearly 49% of global real-time payment volumes, expanding across 11 international countries.
PhonePe: Leads market value share at ~46.26%.
Merchant Adoption: Person-to-merchant (P2M) transactions drive 63% of total volume, with 86% under ₹500.
Peer Transfers: Person-to-person (P2P) transfers continue to anchor high-value transactions, contributing roughly 70% of total transferred value.
Infrastructure Support: Backed by ubiquitous smartphone access, robust 5G connectivity, and zero-fee merchant onboarding models.
